searchText: London is ready for testnets 🇬🇧🎉 See the full announcement, with versions for each of the clients, here: https://blog.ethereum.org/2021/06/18/london-testnets-announcement/ Worth noting that if you are running an Eth2 testnet, you will also need to upgrade your Goerli node 👀 Another post will be out with the mainnet versions as soon as they are ready.
